summary: A good quality conversion close to the poplar and scenic village of Orton.
description:
Located close to the popular and charming village of Orton, situated in the Westmorland Dales National Park, and with easy access to the M6, Penrith and Kendal, this deceptively spacious 2 bedroomed cottage, is available to let to discerning tenants.

Finished in neutral tones, and with original features including exposed brickwork and beams, this attractive cottage is sure to be a popular one

The accommodation briefly comprises: Porch, Kitchen Diner, Utility, Lounge, 2 Bedrooms, Bathroom, Garden, Off Road Parking, Electric Heating & DG.

Services Mains water, drainage and electricity.
